privacy.keyLimitsBody: The concurrency and RPM limits you set for a service key apply to both personal and charity model calls. Your account export includes these settings. Administrators and level-5 stewards can read them on resources they are authorized to manage, but cannot change them. The settings are deleted with the key.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the data used to operate a NonbiriAPI instance.
privacy.notice: Deployment template: before accepting real users, the instance operator must replace the operator identity, contact channel, effective date, retention details and governing-law statements as required by the deployment and applicable law. This text is not legal advice.
privacy.operatorBody: NonbiriAPI is open-source software. Each deployed instance is operated independently by the person or organization that controls it. This policy applies to data processed by that operator, not to the public source repository or to Discord and third-party AI services acting under their own policies.
privacy.identityBody: The user station uses Discord for registration and sign-in. The service receives a Discord identifier, username, avatar information, and the membership information needed to check server and role eligibility. Sign-in tokens are used only during sign-in and are not stored as account data. The service keeps limited account, sign-in, and preference information and protects sign-in cookies according to the deployment configuration.
privacy.dataBody: The service stores addresses, notes, enabled status, service types, discovered models, platform model names, and model connections for endpoints owned by your account. Some OpenAI-compatible resources can also save settings such as “do not store requests” and “convert tool calls to text”; these settings do not contain request content. Service keys are encrypted. An account API key is shown in full only once; afterward, only information needed to verify and identify it remains. The service also stores check-ins, donations and charity use, daily activities, account restrictions, usage limits, game-profile visibility, game results and best scores, plus limited information needed to prevent abuse and calculate charges. Export version 4 includes safe endpoint source information, donated-key permission and active end times, and safe source details. Exports exclude full keys, encrypted key content, report-matching data, source-key identities, administrator notes, sign-in tokens, Debug content, random data, and other users' identities.
privacy.creditHistoryBody: You can view and filter your own credit history. Entries related to your API calls can link to your request logs while those logs remain available. Donation rewards do not reveal another user's request ID or logs. Request-log expiry does not remove credit history.
privacy.economyBody: The service stores your single spendable Nonbiri credit balance, which may be negative, together with check-in awards, game rewards, and charity-use summaries. Check-in awards, donor rewards, and game rewards add to the same balance; charity calls and game costs subtract from it. The cumulative donor-reward total is used only for donation summaries and level requirements; it is not a second wallet, and ordinary spending, check-ins, and normal game events do not change it. Every balance change is recorded. Game prices, random results, funds set aside for play, recovery, and settlement are handled consistently by the game system. No game outcome or economic return is guaranteed, and level 4 provides no game-economy advantage. Leaderboards are anonymous by default. If you choose to make your profile public, your current server nickname or username and Discord avatar URL are shown together. The service does not keep a copy of that avatar or copy profile identity into historical game records.
privacy.credentialsBody: Service keys are never returned in ordinary lists, logs, alerts, errors, exports, or URLs. The browser receives only the information needed to describe a key and does not save the full service key or account API key. Deleting a key or account immediately stops future calls through it. Encrypted key content that no longer belongs to any resource is cleared within one hour. An OpenAI-compatible key can ask the connected service not to store requests (store=false), but that service may ignore or reject the request. This is not a promise of zero retention and does not control the provider's abuse monitoring. Operators must still protect the server, complete backups, and master-key file.
privacy.trafficBody: Forwarded requests create limited records such as the account, model, service used, time, status, duration, and available token usage. Ordinary request and response content is not stored long term. Debug starts in preview mode: it does not access a key, send a request outside the site, set aside charity credits, or record usage. Each real send requires separate confirmation and may use provider quota or charity credits. Request and response summaries with sensitive content removed exist only in the current process and page memory. They are not written to the database, ordinary logs, alerts, exports, backups, URLs, or browser storage, and are cleared when the session closes, is replaced, or expires, and on sign-out, restriction, account deletion, or service restart. Disconnecting the Debug page does not cancel an original request made with an account API key. Administrators and active level-5 stewards see only limited request details, and stewards cannot see donated resources.
privacy.sharingBody: Request content may be sent to OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible services selected by the account owner, including donor-provided charity resources operated by OpenAI, Anthropic, or another independent third party. A third party may process or retain request content, account logs, or abuse-monitoring data under its own policy, which the instance operator cannot control. A charity donor controls the related third-party account or key and may therefore see full request content in that service's account logs. This site's interface does not show the user's identity or request content to the donor. Each forwarded request also includes a system-generated safety code that can be linked only for the same user, deployment, and third-party service. It hides direct identity but is not fully anonymous. Discord processes sign-in activity under its own policy. The operator may disclose data when required by law or needed to protect the service, users, or public safety, and must describe access by other data processors, hosting providers, and support staff.
privacy.retentionBody: Request logs are kept for up to 30 days. Records of completed donations and reviews, daily activity summaries, and completed charity payment holds are kept for 400 days. After a donated key ends or its service key is deleted, non-reversible information used only to match new abuse reports may remain for up to 90 days and cannot be used to make a call. The minimum target and donation-source relationship already saved for a report follows that case's own 90-day period or an active legal preservation requirement. Viewing a record does not extend these periods, and legal preservation does not extend the new-report matching period. Game rounds, settlements, and shared results are kept for 30 days after settlement; a paid but unfinished round remains until settlement, and a private Rock Paper Scissors result remains until you acknowledge it or delete the account. Game best scores, credit changes, and profile-visibility preferences remain for the life of the account. Debug content is not stored long term. Sign-in sessions expire after inactivity or their maximum lifetime. Resolved administrator alerts are cleared after 30 days; unresolved alerts are subject to number limits and duplicate merging. Export version 4 allows up to 10,000 rows in each collection and 16 MiB for the complete JSON. An oversized export fails clearly and is not shortened. Account deletion invalidates sign-in sessions and account API keys, clears linked private data, and keeps only necessary facts without personal identity for the periods described above. Late callbacks cannot recreate the account. Complete operator backups and third-party services may retain copies under their own policies.
privacy.rightsBody: Subject to applicable law and the instance operator's process, you can update supported account settings, request an export and delete your account through the elevated self-service flow. Deletion is destructive. Contact the instance operator for access, correction, restriction or other privacy requests; the operator must publish the appropriate contact channel before production use.
privacy.securityBody: The service checks resource ownership, encrypts stored keys, prevents requests from reaching protected network locations or following dangerous redirects, limits resource use, and stops later work when a request is cancelled. Sensitive responses ask browsers and intermediate services not to cache them. The OpenAI-only “convert tool calls to text” experiment converts only complete real calls and results. It never runs tools or invents results and may affect normal tool workflows; Anthropic connections cannot use it. No system is completely secure. Do not place keys in notes, model names, URLs, tool data, issue reports, or support messages.
privacy.contactBody: The instance operator must publish a privacy contact, effective date and applicable jurisdiction in this page before production use. Material changes to data collection, sharing or retention should be announced and handled according to applicable law.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: By using a NonbiriAPI instance, you agree to use it lawfully and protect your own credentials.
terms.notice: Deployment template: the instance operator must replace the operator identity, contact channel, effective date, governing law and complaint process before accepting real users. This text is not legal advice.
terms.operatorBody: NonbiriAPI is open-source gateway software, not an AI model provider. The operator of a particular instance controls its access rules, connected third-party services, limits, maintenance, and user support. The public source project and its copyright holder do not automatically operate every deployment.
terms.accessBody: An account may require Discord OAuth and membership of a configured server and role. You are responsible for activity performed through your account and must provide information that is accurate enough for the operator's access and support process. The operator may pause new registration or suspend access for security, maintenance, legal compliance or a breach of these terms.
terms.useBody: Use only endpoints, credentials and models that you are authorized to access. Do not use the service for unlawful activity, fraud, abuse, unauthorized access, credential theft, malware, harassment, privacy violations, sexual exploitation of minors, non-consensual intimate imagery, attacks against providers or other users, denial of service, rate-limit bypassing or attempts to defeat ownership and security controls.
terms.upstreamBody: Requests may be processed by OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible services selected by the account owner, including donor-provided charity resources. You must follow each service provider's terms, usage policies, licensing conditions, and content restrictions. A provider may keep request content, account logs, or abuse-monitoring data under its own policy. A request not to store content (store:false) may be ignored or rejected and is not a promise of zero retention. The operator does not guarantee that a third party will accept a request, preserve content, or keep an account available.
terms.credentialsBody: Keep service keys, account API keys, sign-in links, and recovery information confidential. Replace a key immediately if it may have been exposed. Do not put keys in notes, URLs, model names, tools, issue reports, or support messages. You are responsible for submitted content and must have the right to send it to the selected provider. The experimental “convert tool calls to text” feature changes only how calls are displayed and sent. It does not run a tool, create a result, or prove success, and it may affect programs that expect structured tool calls.
terms.availabilityBody: Requests may be rate-limited, rejected, retried, or temporarily unavailable because of quotas, resource ownership, safety checks, third-party failures, maintenance, or permissions. A complete response is required for success; an HTTP status alone does not guarantee the result. Debug preview sends nothing outside the site, while a separately confirmed real send may consume provider quota or charity credits. Game prices, random results, recovery, and settlement are handled consistently by the game system and offer no guaranteed result or return. The operator may change limits or discontinue a prerelease service.
terms.dataBody: The privacy policy describes information stored by the service, Debug handling, exports, and account deletion. After identity verification, deleting an account removes linked donation, charity, check-in, credit-change, and game data. The service opens only a structurally complete database that passes validation; an unrecognized, damaged, or incompatible database is rejected. A separately confirmed clean deployment first creates and verifies a complete snapshot, then removes the current database—including accounts, business data, site settings, and custom legal text—and starts with an empty database. A protected operator backup may retain the database, program, environment, and master key for recovery. The new environment must remain in maintenance with registration, activities, charity access, donation intake, and games closed until legal text, required settings, and initial data have been reapplied and checked. Backup recovery and third-party data retention follow the operator's and provider's respective policies.
terms.suspensionBody: The operator may suspend or terminate access when reasonably necessary to protect the service or users, comply with law or investigate a suspected breach. Where safe and lawful, the operator may provide notice. You may stop using the service and request account deletion through the supported flow.
terms.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the service is provided as-is and as available, without a promise of uninterrupted operation, that every request reaches the expected service, model accuracy, data availability, or fitness for a particular purpose. The operator is not responsible for third-party provider decisions or content generated by third-party systems. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
terms.ipBody: The NonbiriAPI source code is available under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. NonbiriAPI, Discord, OpenAI, and other names may be trademarks of their respective owners; this project is not automatically affiliated with or endorsed by third-party providers. Rights in submitted or generated content depend on your rights, applicable law, and third-party service terms.
terms.changesBody: The operator may update these terms for a new release or operational change. Material changes should state an effective date and be communicated as required by applicable law. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance where legally valid; otherwise stop using the service and contact the operator. The operator must publish a contact channel and governing-law statement before production use.
